ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; estimated ratio of 0.05:0.95 (high-intensity to low-intensity) based on localized white barnacle clusters and surface scarring against a dominant dark field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black/dark grey) base layer across 98% of visible fluke area. High-contrast white contiguous geometric blobs (barnacles) mapped to distal left and right lobe tips. Minor high-intensity linear mottling at inner-left lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 40-degree V-shaped depression; vertex point is partially occluded by water surface turbulence and splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-10 pixel depth) present along the entire trailing edge; continuous irregular peaks and valleys isolated from background water pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior boundary of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal linear disruption (approx. 45-degree angle) on the right lobe surface; multiple faint vertical parallel lines (rake marks) detected on the proximal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of white barnacles at fluke tips; visible linear scratch marks on the ventral surface pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water turbulence and foam masking the peduncle and the lower portion of the median notch.
